test_summary: Sol repair T8R-01/T8R-02: initial scoped ptest regression run observed 5/5 failures: undeclared ignored content remained clean/absent, ignored runtime inputs were absent both alone and with docs, a CRLF-only converted input did not produce raw evidence/full, and the configured process filter executed its marker. Mechanical source-only stash proof reproduced the same 5 failures; restoring e26374e made the focused 5/5 pass. Final permitted scope: ptest tests/ng/test_source.py tests/ng/test_selection.py --tb=short --durations=20 => 80 passed in 5.55s, exit 0; slowest 0.62s. T8R-01 now inventories all Git-ignored files within the cumulative bounds, fingerprints them, emits ignored changes unless covered by declared ignored_inputs or a validated disjoint non_input_output, and never treats Git-ignore status itself as an exemption. T8R-02 removes worktree-converting Git status/diff calls, compares bounded raw worktree blob identities with index OIDs, marks attribute/autocrlf conversion uncertainty as raw/unclassifiable, and rejects effective filter.* configuration before any worktree content operation. git diff --check => exit 0. graphify update . => exit 0 (AST only, 3607 nodes/7425 edges/233 communities). No raw runner, full suite, network/provider smoke, installation, push or deployment performed.
concerns: T11 integration blocker: no CLI/executor caller yet supplies native runtime facts. snapshot(domain, config, baseline, base, *, runtime_identity=None) preserves the positional API and returns compatibility=None plus a limitation by default. A supplied 64-hex identity must represent verified native runner/interpreter/plugin/effective-config/coverage/dependency facts, refreshed after setup and queue waits; the test digest is an explicit unit boundary, not verified native support. Static scanning never probes/imports runner code. T11 must integrate execution-only ensure_fingerprint_key, snapshot revalidation after queue wait and group quiescence, changed-input incomplete outcomes, and actual native inventory checks. revalidation.json is exercised as source evidence, not an executor integration claim.

History integration blocker outside ownership: history._eligible_baseline currently requires both clean and an empty changes tuple. Source now correctly allows clean=True with committed baseline..HEAD changes. T11/History must permit a successful unchanged clean full gate to publish a baseline when its only changes are committed deltas; it must still reject dirty worktrees, missing compatibility/limitations, or differing pre/post input identity or HEAD. Do not discard committed deltas to satisfy the old history predicate.

Minimal internal contract addition: InputSnapshot.baseline_head defaults to None and choose_plan rejects absent/mismatched provenance. History's snapshot codec and shared test factories were not modified; fresh source snapshots are required for planning, and callers constructing selectable snapshots must explicitly bind the baseline. No Baseline or public JSON schema fields changed.

Ignored content is now inventoried repository-wide through bounded Git evidence and fingerprinted; undeclared ignored files emit ignored changes and prevent narrowing even when mixed with no-tests/docs changes. Declared ignored_inputs remain explicit inputs whose fingerprints bind compatibility. Only a declared non_input_output that passes the existing disjointness validation is exempt. Consequently ordinary ignored caches can conservatively force full or hit the scan envelope until a later supported profile supplies a validated narrow output declaration. Git still does not inventory arbitrary untracked special files such as FIFOs; a known tracked input replaced by a FIFO fails safely.

Static source inspection no longer asks Git to compare worktree contents. Staged evidence is tree/index-only; unstaged evidence comes from descriptor-bounded raw byte reads and Git blob identities. Effective filter.* configuration yields an unknown-input limitation before content inspection, and check-attr only classifies conversion attributes without applying them. A raw mismatch under text/eol/filter/ident/working-tree-encoding or non-false core.autocrlf is emitted as raw and forces full. This deliberately widens repositories whose checked-out representation differs from the index until richer conversion evidence is designed.

Every tracked file remains an input, even under a declared output prefix; only disjoint declared untracked outputs are exempt. Mode changes, index hiding flags, symlinks, gitlinks, conflicts, in-progress operations and partial clones conservatively prevent identity/selection. This can run more tests than a future profile with richer evidence.

The one 10s deadline covers all Git processes, parsing, file reads and final checks, with a cumulative 32MiB Git capture cap plus 100k files/16MiB per file/512MiB contents. Checks occur before/after bounded operations; Python cannot preempt an uninterruptible kernel/filesystem call. Repeated descriptor metadata and Git checks detect observed races but are not an atomic filesystem snapshot. T11 must retain the before/after execution revalidation boundary.

Verification was Linux deterministic scope only. No macOS execution, native runner integration, or full suite was run under this task's scoped-only instructions. No CI secret/static/dependency scanning gates are configured in this checkout; none were installed. Graph update reported four JSON files with zero AST nodes (implementation.json, review.json, protocol-v1.json, revalidation.json); the code graph updated successfully without semantic extraction, and its community/wiki metadata was not used after the update.
